Name: Found ring. Gift from Marlon
Author: scarboy17
Description:
Marlon was out exploring the mines when he came across a ring. He decided to send it to the new farmer in town to help them out. You will receive it in the mail on the 10th of spring year 1. 5 days after the mines open.

In the newest update Mail Framework Mod is no longer needed and instead just need Content Patcher. You are also able to customize the season, Day of delivery and which ring you will receive. Choosing the day will schedule your delivery for the next day.
